newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end down on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end down on profit-taking.

text.p: Investors took advantage of the weaker international tone to take some profit, pushing the PSI20 index down nearly a full point.
Traders said that the profit-taking could continue on Monday barring any positive new developments.

Soares da Costa moved against the trend, closing over nine percent up at 1,703 escudos on speculation that a bid may be launched for the construction firm despite its denial that Teixeira Duarte had already made an offer.
Ship repairer Lisnave tumbled on the capital writedown, while Sonae Investimentos, a recent gainer, also came in for some heavy profit-taking, losing nearly four percent.
"On Monday, I think prices are going to continue to correct even if the decline will probably be less significant. Much will depend on how New York closes," said one trader.
